cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't sweep yet. We establish how the vase broke before we disturb the pieces.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you got glue on your fingers?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We identify the adhesive before drawing conclusions. Bring me the tube, by the cap, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's a piece of the vase stuck to your thumb.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then photograph it before we remove it. Honestly, must I label my own thumb for you?

reason: Remove invented pulling and explanatory superiority claim; the attached shard now directly causes a photography instruction and strained labelling correction.
